<!-- The crowded cases: a chart-controls bar of four sliders in a grid (label
     above track), and a panel with three sliders sharing one grid row --
     where slider tracks were once squeezed to 0px by Observable Inputs'
     runtime styles. One column, no split. -->

```{ojs}
//| output: false
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```

<div class="vm-app">

<div class="ojs-panel">

<div class="ojs-grid">

```{ojs}
viewof prevalence = Inputs.range([0, 1], {step: 0.01, value: 0.1, label: "Prevalence"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof sensitivity = Inputs.range([0, 1], {step: 0.01, value: 0.9, label: "Sensitivity"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof specificity = Inputs.range([0, 1], {step: 0.01, value: 0.95, label: "Specificity"})
```

</div>

</div>

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

<div class="ojs-chart-controls ojs-grid">

```{ojs}
viewof alpha = Inputs.range([0, 1], {step: 0.01, value: 0.5, label: "Smoothing α"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof noiseR = Inputs.range([0.01, 10], {step: 0.01, value: 1, label: "Measurement noise R"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof noiseQ = Inputs.range([0.01, 10], {step: 0.01, value: 0.1, label: "Process noise Q"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof samples = Inputs.range([10, 500], {step: 1, value: 100, label: "Samples"})
```

</div>

```{ojs}
mainPlot = {
  const x = [], y = []
  let level = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
    level = alpha * Math.sin(i / 10) * noiseR + (1 - alpha) * level * noiseQ
    x.push(i)
    y.push(level + prevalence * sensitivity * specificity)
  }
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.className = "plotly-box-large"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, [{x, y, showlegend: false, line: {color: chartColors.fn}}],
    VM.plotting.layout({xaxis: {range: [0, 500]}, yaxis: {range: [-12, 12]}}), VM.plotting.config())
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```

</div>

</div>
